purpose: Separate changed algorithm work from sensitivity to linked instruction addresses. Include the unpadded layout, positive PowerPC formatting path, passive PowerPC scan, and previously affected LoongArch and ARC paths.
scope: An inert text object is placed between one compiled consumer and an unchanged archive for each source variant. No instruction in the padding is executed. All layouts and A/A observations are retained, regardless of sign. This does not reproduce Stabilizer randomization or establish a general normal distribution, and it does not by itself qualify a release.
prior_evidence: R1200 heap shifts did not remove the passive slowdown. R1203 PIE versus ET_EXEC changed the effect, but also changed relative text layout. This experiment keeps PIE and changes a declared text displacement instead.
